title: Add per-route metrics + dashboards for quantization profile rollouts
creator: Paula Mendes
description:
Goal: Make route-level quantization profile rollouts safe and debuggable by adding per-route metrics + standard dashboards/alerts for (a) enabled/applied state, (b) quality guardrail signals, (c) error rates and fallback outcomes, and (d) latency + cost deltas.

Context
- Quantization Profile Library is opt-in, enabled per route (and optionally constrained by region/deployment tier). We need to answer quickly:
  1) Is a profile enabled for a route?
  2) Is it actually being applied in runtime or falling back?
  3) Are we seeing compatibility/integrity failures?
  4) Did latency/cost change materially? Did errors/quality signals worsen?

Deliverables
1) Metrics (exported to Redwood metrics pipeline) with consistent naming + dimensions
2) Grafana dashboard pack (templated) for per-route rollout monitoring + fleet overview
3) Alert rules + suggested thresholds for beta/GA (esp. fallback spikes and 5xx)
4) Runbook links + "how to confirm" workflow using request_id/trace_id

Metric requirements
A) Route-level enabled/applied state
- runtime.quant_profile.resolution_total (counter)
  - labels: route_id, tenant_id, model_id, model_variant, region, deployment_tier, quant_profile_id, quant_profile_version, outcome
  - outcome enum: applied | disabled | fallback_incompatible | fallback_killswitch | fallback_profile_not_found | fallback_integrity_check_failed | fallback_runtime_unsupported | error
- runtime.quant_profile.applied_ratio (derived; dashboard calc)
  - applied / sum(outcomes)
- controlplane.route_quant_profile.target (gauge)
  - labels: route_id, tenant_id, target_ref
  - target_ref: default | profile:<quant_profile_id>@<version> | alias:recommended (beta only; if supported)

B) Quality / guardrail signals (production-facing)
- guardrails.quant_profile.block_total (counter)
  - emitted when policy engine blocks enablement OR runtime disables due to guardrail gate
  - labels: route_id, tenant_id, model_id, quant_profile_id, reason
  - reason enum: eval_gate_failed | profile_deprecated | profile_experimental_disallowed | promptset_regression | manual_hold
- (Beta) guardrails.quant_profile.eval_status (gauge)
  - values: 0 unknown, 1 pass, 2 warn, 3 fail (documented)
  - labels: model_id, quant_profile_id, promptset
  - Note: this is for Redwood internal / beta; customer console should show "Pass/Warn/Fail" without raw promptset names.

C) Errors + fallback debugging
- inference.requests_total / inference.errors_total already exist; add quant labels to request logs/traces (from ENG-5816) and ensure metrics can be broken down by quant_profile_id/outcome.
- runtime.quant_profile.metadata_fetch_total + runtime.quant_profile.metadata_fetch_errors_total (counters)
  - labels: source=registry|cache, error_type
  - used to catch thundering herd / retry storms

D) Latency + cost deltas
- inference.latency_ms (histogram) segmented by quant_profile_id + outcome
  - labels: route_id, tenant_id, model_id, region, deployment_tier, quant_profile_id, outcome
- inference.decode_latency_ms (histogram) segmented by quant_profile_id (decode regressions were observed in runtime thread; we need explicit visibility)
- inference.cost_usd_estimate_total (counter) + inference.tokens_total (counter) segmented by quant_profile_id
  - dashboard computes usd_per_1k_tokens = cost / tokens * 1000
  - Note: cost estimate is Redwood internal; for customers, surface relative deltas + "Estimated" label.

Dashboards
1) Quantization Profiles: Rollout Overview (fleet)
- Panels:
  - Enabled routes count (by region/tier)
  - Applied ratio (top N routes by traffic)
  - Fallback rate time series (stacked by outcome)
  - Error rate (5xx, timeouts) split by outcome
  - Latency p50/p95 delta (quantized vs disabled baseline) per route
  - Cost per 1k tokens delta (quantized vs disabled baseline) per route
- Filters: env, tenant_id, route_id, model_id, region, deployment_tier, quant_profile_id

2) Quantization Profiles: Route Drilldown
- Panels:
  - Config target (controlplane gauge) + last change time (from audit events; link)
  - Resolution outcome stacked area
  - p95 latency + decode latency overlay by outcome
  - Throughput (tokens/s) and queueing if available
  - Registry fetch errors (metadata/artifact) + cache hit rate
  - Top incompatibility reasons (table)

3) Quantization Profiles: Beta Guardrails
- Panels:
  - guardrails block events by reason
  - eval_status for active profiles (internal)
  - "regression alert" annotations (from guardrail service)

Alerts (initial thresholds; can tune during canary)
- Fallback spike: fallback_rate > 2% for 10m on a single route with >X rpm (beta default X=200 rpm)
- Integrity/metadata errors: fallback_integrity_check_failed > 0.1% for 5m (high severity)
- 5xx increase correlated with outcome=error or metadata_fetch_errors_total increases
- Latency regression: p95 +20% vs 24h baseline (warning), +35% (page) for high-traffic routes (guarded by minimum sample)

Acceptance criteria
- Metrics emitted in hosted + dedicated environments, end-to-end validated in perf-canary.
- Dashboard pack published to standard Grafana folder "Optimize / Quantization Profiles" and linked from rollback runbook.
- SRE can answer with a single drilldown: "Is profile applied for request_id X? If not, why?" (requires quant_profile_id + outcome in logs/traces).
- Alert rules created in staging, promoted to prod with beta thresholds.

Notes / links
- Runtime selection + metrics hooks: see ENG-5816
- Compatibility/fallback spec: Confluence "quantization-profile-compatibility-and-fallbacks"
- Rollback runbook: Confluence "rollback-procedure-quantization-profiles"
comments:
2025-01-22 — Aisha Bello: Drafted metric list and dashboard outline. Main gap: we need a stable label set across control plane + runtime so we can join config target (what user asked for) vs applied outcome (what actually happened). Proposed: always emit route_id + tenant_id + region + deployment_tier; include quant_profile_id/version when known, else "none".

Also flagging cardinality risk: tenant_id + route_id can be high but bounded; quant_profile_id/version should be low. We should avoid request_id in metrics (logs/traces only).

2025-01-29 — Logan Wright: +1 to avoiding request_id in metrics. Please ensure we have an outcome enum that captures kill-switch separately; we want to detect emergency disable effectiveness. Also add registry fetch error counters to catch metadata retry storms (we saw a similar pattern with model manifest fetch last quarter).

2025-02-03 — Caleb Johnson: For latency: capture both end-to-end latency and decode latency. Decode regressions are often hidden in total latency because queueing varies. If runtime can emit decode histogram with quant_profile_id label, that would be ideal.

If runtime cannot emit directly, we can derive decode from spans in tracing, but metrics from spans will lag and be sampled.

2025-02-07 — Nadia Rahman: Cost panel: we can compute usd_per_1k_tokens from existing cost attribution metrics if quant_profile_id is attached as a dimension to the request cost record. Confirmed with billing pipeline: adding a low-cardinality string dimension is OK. Please coordinate label name exactly (quant_profile_id).

2025-02-18 — Aisha Bello: Implementation plan updated after sync with Chloe Martin + runtime folks:
- Runtime will emit resolution_total + outcome (ENG-5816).
- Control plane will emit a gauge for configured target_ref (best-effort; if too costly, we can derive from audit + config DB). Ethan confirmed gauge is cheap to export from config resolver cache.
- Console will deep-link to Route Drilldown dashboard for operators (later).

Starting dashboard pack in staging. Will reuse existing "Route Health" templates for filters.

2025-03-04 — Aisha Bello: Dashboards created in staging folder (Optimize / Quantization Profiles). Added panels for applied ratio, fallback outcomes, latency p95, decode latency p95, cost per 1k tokens estimate.

Noted: outcome=error was mixing runtime selection errors and downstream inference 5xx. Added a separate metric runtime.quant_profile.selection_errors_total to avoid conflating.
2025-03-11 — Connor O'Brien: Ran through rollout checklist; dashboards are now linked from the rollback runbook. Please add alert rules in staging and get SRE signoff before promoting to prod.

2025-03-18 — Aisha Bello: Alerts shipped to prod with conservative thresholds (fallback_rate>2%/10m, integrity failures>0.1%/5m, metadata_fetch_errors spikes). Verified drilldown flow using request trace: quant_profile_id and outcome show up in logs and trace attributes.

Marking Done.
